subject: Compliance add-on packaging proposal for NovusHealth
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@novushealth.com>, Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@novushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance add-on packaging proposal for NovusHealth

Hi Susan / Tom,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on scope for the pilot and the eventual production roll. As promised, attaching a quick pricing sketch for the compliance/security add-ons you asked about: audit log retention tiers, KMS/HSM licensing, and regional (US-only) residency. The attached workbook has line-item math; below is the short version so we can iterate quickly.

Topline options (monthly):
- Audit logs: 30d retention = $0/month (included), 1 year retention = $1,250/mo, 3 year retention = $3,000/mo (storage + retrieval SLA)
- KMS/HSM: per-HSM-seat model: $4,000/mo per HSM (recommended for FIPS/HIPAA customers) OR per-crypt-request billing: $0.0006 per request (good for low-key use)
- Residency (US-only): standard = included, sovereign region (private VPC in AWS us-east-1 dedicated tenancy) = $3,500/mo (infra and network isolation)

Pilot concession: we can offer a one-month credit on HSM seat fees for the pilot (limit 1 seat) and a 50% credit on 3rd-party onboarding professional services up to $7,500. This helps surface infra questions without locking you into long-term amortization.

Open questions for you:
1) Do you expect heavy KMS usage (>10M crypto ops/mo) or is it mostly occasional keys?
2) Audit log retention - is 1 year sufficient, or do you need 3 years for compliance?
3) Do you need an SLA-backed committed commit for latency (we can add dedicated throughput on Redwood Dedicated if needed)?

I'll loop Ben and Laura in on the commercial details once you confirm which direction you prefer and what the pilot acceptance criteria look like.

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Novus_Compliance_Pricing.xlsx (xlsx), Novus_SoW_Draft.pdf (pdf)
From: Susan Park <susan.park@novushealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@novushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on packaging proposal for NovusHealth

Thanks Michael — this is helpful. A few clarifying points from our compliance and infra teams: 

- KMS usage: Primarily for signing tokens and occasional data encryption keys. We estimate ~2–3M operations/month initially, scaling to ~8–10M in year two.
- Audit logs: We have an internal policy that prefers 3-year retention for patient-facing services; can you confirm retrieval costs and expected egress SLA for long-term retention?
- Residency: we will need VPC isolation with audit logging routed to our S3 (so we can own the long-term retention). Is that supported?

Also — for procurement, we prefer multi-month pilots billed monthly with a small committed discount vs single-month pilot credits. Would Redwood be open to a 3-month pilot at 75% of full pilot price with the HSM seat credit spread across the pilot instead of a single free month?

Thanks,
Susan Park
Director of Compliance 
NovusHealth

> Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on scope for the pilot and the eventual production roll. As promised, attaching a quick pricing sketch...
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on packaging proposal for NovusHealth

Susan — thanks for the detail. Short answers inline and a proposed commercial tweak below.

- KMS usage: 2–3M ops/month maps well to per-request billing; above ~6–8M/month you'd see better economics with dedicated HSM seats. We'll model both in the spreadsheet.
- Audit logs (3yr): retrieval costs are modest — we estimate $0.02/GB retrieval for archived data, and we guarantee read availability within 24 hours for archived tiers. For active (hot) retention we provide <1s query latency. I'll add explicit retrieval numbers to the workbook.
- VPC isolation to your S3: yes, we can configure log streaming to a customer-owned bucket (customer-managed keys). We'll include that in the SoW as an integration task.

Proposal tweak: 3-month pilot at 75% of list for the add-ons (audit logs + KMS) with the HSM seat credited 50% each month (i.e., spread the seat concession across the pilot). Professional services credit remains $7,500. If you convert to annual committed Dedicated capacity within 60 days after pilot, we'll credit back the pilot discount against the first invoice.

Ben — can you produce a one-page line-item that shows the monthly recurring + pilot pricing under both per-request and HSM-seat models? Laura — I left the SoW with a placeholder for delivery timeline.

Best,
Michael

Hi all — attached a concise price table (pasted below) and assumptions. See excel for the math.

-- Price table (monthly, USD) --
Scenario A — Per-request KMS
- Audit logs 3yr (archived + hot mix): $3,000/mo
- KMS per-request (2.5M ops/mo): $0.0006/op => $1,500/mo
- Residency (private VPC + log streaming): $3,500/mo
Total (A): $8,000/mo

Scenario B — HSM seat (recommended at scale)
- Audit logs 3yr: $3,000/mo
- HSM seat (1 seat): $4,000/mo
- Residency: $3,500/mo
Total (B): $10,500/mo

Pilot commercial (3 months at 75%):
- Scenario A pilot: $6,000/mo for 3 months (total $18,000)
- Scenario B pilot: $7,875/mo for 3 months (total $23,625)
- HSM seat credit: 50%/month during pilot (applies only to Scenario B)
- PS credit: $7,500 applied on first invoice

Assumptions / notes:
- Retrieval costs for archived audit logs estimated at $0.02/GB; excluded from the monthly totals unless retrieval events occur.
- Upgrades to dedicated throughput would add a predictable committed fee (TBD based on qps).
- Taxes, WAF, and third-party connectors are not included.

Happy to run sensitivity on ops-per-month if you want a side-by-side for 5M, 8M, 12M.

Ben Carter
Senior Pricing Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Novus_Compliance_Pricing.xlsx
From: Susan Park <susan.park@novushealth.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tom Wallace <tom.wallace@novushealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on packaging proposal for NovusHealth

Thanks Ben — that table makes the tradeoffs clear. A couple of procurement asks before we move to signature: 

1) Can Redwood accept Net 45 for pilot invoices? Procurement will push for Net 60, but Net 45 is what we can get approved quickly.
2) Can you add a limited liability cap for the pilot (standard contracting language) and a 30-day termination clause for the pilot only?
3) For the SoW, please add a line item that Redwood will deliver the log-streaming integration and do the initial verification with our infra team (1 day of validation included).

If we get those in writing, we can fast-track procurement and aim to start the pilot the week of Aug 17.

Thanks,
Susan
